text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. An information session 
was held for those who were interested in 
Mecha Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful to all of you for gathering 
here. So many of you...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Wait, only six people? Considering that 
demonstration, I suppose it can't be 
helped, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Six of us had gathered: myself, Symboli 
Kris S, Air Shakur, Tanino Gimlet, Biwa 
Hayahide, and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sing out, Princess of the Wheels. Unleash 
the impulse packed into this tin can—its 
primal origin!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: An impulse... poured into a tin can?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In short, we wish to know your motive for 
development. Why did you create Mecha 
Umamusume, Professor?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"My motive? Very well. Then let me tell 
you an old tale. Back when I was still..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...about the time when I was a student at 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Which means Dr. Reitz is effectively a 
senior colleague to the five gathered 
here, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I couldn't win again... But 
that was fun! Next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(It's not like I was particularly 
talented. Nor was I exceptionally strong. 
Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(I just loved to run. I was merely one of 
those ordinary Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
If only I could run just a little 
faster...! If only I could see a slightly 
better view...!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(My dream was a very, very small one. Not 
victory, nor success, I just wanted to see 
the scenery rush by a little faster than 
it does now.)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: (However—the gods would not allow it.)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Huh... Then never again...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if fully recovered... managing 
to walk will be the absolute limit. Living 
in a wheelchair... will be unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, racing is out of the 
question now... I recommend retirement.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Not being able to race... That's fine. I 
don't mind. But... never being able to run 
again...?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Do I have... no choice but to give up...?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Right, being able to run however I 
pleased is already in the past..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I have to... forget... If I don't forget, 
it'll only hurt more..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yet... these feelings. Even so... no 
matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be wiped away completely. I 
am... an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I want to feel it. Once more, running with 
my own legs... the pure bliss of cutting 
through the wind!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, people created automobiles, 
locomotives, and airplanes to make life 
more convenient. However...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"My inventions are not for some greater 
good. They are rooted in extremely 
selfish, self-centered desires."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I want to run once more, and 
experience the scenery flowing by with my 
own senses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, even if we complete the Mecha 
Umamusume, that alone won't allow her to 
compete in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Dr. Wright's dream wasn't 
anything so grandiose—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was something far more modest, and 
fleeting.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
This is the unvarnished truth of the 
situation. I apologize, but even if you 
were to accomplish it...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"There is almost nothing I can offer in 
return to those who help me. Nor is there 
any prospect of turning this into a 
business..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Even so... you girls know a kind of 
running that I don't. That's why I 
desperately need your help.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I want you to be my co-developer. I don't 
know the best way to ask, but... please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone fell silent. Making it a reality 
would be extremely difficult. On top of 
that, it was a challenge with virtually no 
reward, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but Dr. Wright says 'there is no 
compensation,' so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a bit too early to make such a 
sweeping generalization?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Meaning...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Developing the Mecha Umamusume. 
Cooperating with that will lead to a 
deeper understanding of the mechanics of 
running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe there is much to gain from 
understanding the mechanics, or running 
side by side.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If raised properly, it'll become a 
tireless training partner. Even if we 
fail—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as I get my hands on all the data, 
that's fine by me. There's way more in it 
for me that way.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Then...!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
I want to... make an Umamusume's dream 
come true.

I... want to make the dreams of Umamusume 
come true

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to study running even more deeply 
and make <chrname>'s dream come true. And at the 
same time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she wasn't my trainee, I 
wanted to make Dr. Wright's dream come 
true as well, since she was an Umamusume 
just like the others.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I empathize――with you. I shall lend a 
hand――to your mission.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, not really. I don't mind helping 
out if I have some free time.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh, stoke the kiln with fire. 
A price? I care nothing for such things.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"If there is a door barring the way to 
destiny! I'll kick it, batter it down, and 
break right through!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. I'm sorry. You have 
my thanks...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall explain what is 
necessary to enhance Mecha Umamusume ST-2. 
Come, to the laboratory.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I will need you all to train 
as much as possible alongside ST-2, into 
which I have dived.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"By doing so, we accumulate data and aim 
for optimization."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Data collection. Will just that—make you 
faster?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and periodically we'll use the 
"Upgrade Exam" to see just how much ST-2 
has grown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The Upgrade Exam...? What's that? 
Springing it on me all of a sudden like 
that doesn't mean I know what it is...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The "Upgrade Exam" is essentially a mock 
race held in place of a written test.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"And once the Upgrade Exam is over, we'll 
decide on the direction of your training 
based on the results."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: This is what's called "tuning."
choice_data_list:
Is it really okay for me to tune it 
however I like?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As long as I can run, that's all 
that matters to me. I'll leave the fine 
details to you all.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
To summarize— Training → 'Upgrade Exam' → 
Tuning is the basic flow.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
That covers the explanation for now... Now 
then, shall we start training together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I agreed to assist with the 
research on the Mecha Umamusume.
